Name: Let's Move It
Author: Exblosis
Description:
[size=4][size=4][color=#ff7700]Applies to all mods you use: Make backup and do not save the game if you encounter a problematic bug.[/color][/size][b]
[u]
How to use[/u][/b][/size]
With this mod you can select and move various things with simple button presses.

[size=3][b]Pick[/b][/size]
To pick something, hold down the mod key (default [color=#ffff00][b]Left Alt[/b][/color]) and press the move key (default [b][color=#ffff00]Left Mouse[/color][/b]).
When you pick it up, it will follow the mouse cursor.
Multi select (if enabled): Hold down the mod key and hold down the move key and draw a square (Desktop like).

[size=3][b]Placing[/b][/size]
To place a picked up thing, press the move key without holding down the mod key.[color=#ff7700]
[/color]
[size=3][b]Force Placing[/b][/size]
To force placing, hold down (default [color=#ffff00][b]Left Ctrl[/b][/color]) and press the move key.
It is need:
1) To place it outside the map.
2) Because buildings, bushes, etc. have a large bounding box and you want to place it 1 tile further.
3) You want to overlay something. But not all, test it first before deleting anything.
example: Buildings can destroy crops, grass, trees

[size=3][b]Cancel[/b][/size]
To cancel picking up, press the cancel key (default [b][color=#ffff00]Esc[/color][/b]).

[size=3][b]Remove[/b][/size]
To remove a picked up thing, press the remove key (default [color=#ffff00][b]Delete[/b][/color]).

[b][size=3]Copy[/size][/b]
Enable it in the config, it's instead of Moving.
Use it for testing or what you want.

[b][size=3]Config[/size][/b]
You can:
1) Enable and Disable: pick up priority, crop or tea bush separately from farmland or pot
2) Enable and Disable: components
Customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (recommended).

[u][size=4][b]Moveable[/b][/size][size=1][b]
[/b][/size][/u][list]
[*]Player (yourself)
[*]Characters
[*]Monsters
[*]Farm Animals
[*]Buildings (only possible on Farm)
[*]Tilled Earth
[*]Crops
[*]Stumps and Boulders
[*]Giant Crops
[*]Bushes
[*]Placed Craftables
[*]Stones, Sticks, Weeds, etc.
[*]Trees
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4][b][u]Not Moveable[/u][/b][/size]
All objects that are part of the map[size=3].[/size]
eg. some trees, bushes and other things
[size=3]
[/size][size=4][b][u]Notes[/u][/b][/size]
Many of the game's bushes, trees and objects, they are part of the map and cannot be moved with this mod.
Moving villagers that are already moving will most often mess up their pathing.

[size=4][b][u]Translation[/u][/b][/size]
You can add and edit language files.
Please make not a separate mod/translation for it on Nexus, i don't check if they are there.
Go to GitHub and read the [url=https://github.com/Exblosis/StardewValleyMods?tab=readme-ov-file#translations]instructions[/url].
